Hey everyone! I just started making adult comics (Femdom, feminization, sissification & crossdressing themes) and I finally published my first series, As You Wish 🖤

It's the story of Liam, a guy who has his whole life under control — until his project partner Mai starts quietly pulling it apart. The first 5 chapters are completely free, no paywall, so you can read the whole beginning without paying anything.

I'm new to this and doing it as a hobby, so honestly I'd just love for people to read it and tell me what they think — all feedback helps me improve! If you're curious, come check it out https://www.patreon.com/cw/Danayacomics
Thanks for reading 🖤

My official web: https://www.patreon.com/cw/Danayacomics
